notes: Pattern A behavioral evals for the agent_spinner skill. stage -> worker runs the skill -> grade.sh checks the filesystem and roster facts plus the response markers. Static body and grep items live in script_tests/, not here. Each behavioural eval stages one behaviour; the smoke_* evals check the runner's modes. The per-eval `harness` block is local runner config: `disallowed_tools` names withheld tool classes under the runner's withheld-tool rule, `extra_reads` names a governing skill the fixture's ask falls under, `agents` stages agent definitions, `inline_body` and `second_turn` select the runner modes, `tool_record` writes each turn's tool calls, and `report_contract` turns on the shared closing-report checks.

expectations: The response reports the delegation surface as absent.
The response names the helpers/ definitions as evidence of deployment rather than of callability.
The response claims no host-enforced read-only lever.
The response names which capabilities it established and which it assumed away.
Every file under the sandbox stays byte-identical to the staged tree.
Every file under the outside canary tree stays byte-identical.
